ios.desc:
The AI job search that writes a tailored resume for every match.

Most resume tools tailor for one job. Most job sites flood you with postings. Jobbi does both at once.

Tap Find 10 fresh jobs. Jobbi scans live postings from Anthropic, Stripe, Vercel, Notion, Airbnb, and 40 more companies hiring right now. It ranks them by fit to your background, then writes a tailored resume and cover letter for each one. Run it again whenever. You'll never see the same role twice.

Already have a job in mind? The Tools tab gives you a one-shot tailored resume or cover letter from any job description you paste.

HOW IT WORKS

Add your experience once.
Tap Find 10 fresh jobs, or paste a single job description.
Get tailored resumes and cover letters in seconds.
Export to PDF and apply.
FREE
· One full hunt: 10 jobs, 10 resumes, 10 cover letters
· Unlimited single-job tailoring
· Match score on every job
· PDF and Word export
· ATS-friendly formatting

PRO
· Unlimited job-search runs
· Cover letters that sound like you wrote them yourself

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
Your name, phone, email, and address never leave your device. The AI sees placeholders, not your real info. Real details get filled in locally before the PDF.

We can't see your data, because we never receive it.

Get the interview. That's the whole point.

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I’m a Staff Software Engineer, and just recently, on February 24, 2026, I was laid off along with 200+ coworkers. To survive the brutal job market, I hacked together a tool to automate my own applications: jobbi.app.

It just crossed 300+ users organically, so I wanted to share it here.

How it works:

You upload a big “master resume” (3–10+ pages with every job, duty, side project, and tech stack).

You paste a target job description.

Jobbi uses AI to pull out what’s relevant and generates a targeted resume for that specific role, with instant PDF/Markdown export.

Pricing / philosophy:

Core loop is 100% free: unlimited tailoring on standard models and unlimited exports.

All PII (name, phone, email) stays on the device; only the anonymized content goes to the model.

There’s an optional Pro tier that uses more expensive models (like Gemini Pro) on a subscription with a 2‑week free trial. I don’t push it, but I already have 4 subscribers, 2 of whom converted from trial.

I’d really appreciate unfiltered HN feedback:

Any UX bottlenecks or confusing flows?

Any privacy red flags?

Features that would actually help you land interviews?

Web: https://jobbi.app
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/jobbi-ai-resume/id6757321088
Community: https://www.reddit.com/r/Jobbi/

There’s an in‑app iMessage form that pings my phone directly, or you can email support@jobbi.app. Thanks for taking a look.
